weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). At the start of turn 1, grants Special cooldown count-1 to unit. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Res+6 during combat and disables unit's and foe's skills that change attack priority.

special.d: Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to 1.5 x (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to 0.8 × (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).

Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to (unit's Atk - foe's Def or Res). After combat, if unit's Special triggered, grants【Canto (１)】 to unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit for 1 turn (granted even if unit's HP reaches 0).
【Canto (１)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move １ space(s).
(Unit moves according to movement type. Once per turn. Cannot attack or assist. Only highest value applied. Does not stack. After moving, if a skill that grants another action would be triggered (like with Galeforce), Canto will trigger after the granted action. Unit's base movement has no effect on movement granted. Cannot warp (using skills like Wings of Mercy) a distance greater than unit would be able to move with normal Canto movement.)

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+6 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+7 during combat.

b.d: At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-3 on that foe through its next action.
At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-5 on that foe through its next action.
At start of turn, if any foe's Res ≤ unit's Res-3 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Res-7 on that foe through its next action.

At start of turn, if any foe's Res < unit's Res and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts Atk/Res-6 on that foe through its next action. At start of combat, if unit's Res > foe's Res, inflicts Atk/Res-X on foe during combat (X = 3 + highest penalty on each stat between target and foes within 2 spaces of target; calculates each stat penalty independently).

c.d: If unit initiates combat, inflicts Special cooldown count+1 on target and foes within 1 space of target after combat. (No effect on Special cooldown counts already at maximum.)
If unit initiates combat, inflicts Special cooldown count+1 on target and foes within 2 spaces of target after combat. (No effect on Special cooldown counts already at maximum.)
Inflicts Special cooldown count+1 on target and foes within 2 spaces of target after combat. (No effect on Special cooldown counts already at maximum.)
